title: After enabling ipv6 and then reconnecting, ipv6 addresses are not shown in the "Details" tab of plasma-nm applet until Plasma is restarted
line: IPv6 addresses that arrive a moment after connecting now appear in the Networks widget's Details tab without restarting Plasma.
explanation: networkmanager-qt's Device caches its IP4Config/IP6Config details the first time they are read and only drops the cache when the device's Ip4Config/Ip6Config object path changes. NetworkManager creates the IP6Config with just the link-local address and adds the SLAAC/DHCPv6 addresses to that same object a moment later, so the widget (and the KCM status page) kept showing the early snapshot with no global IPv6 address until plasmashell restarted. The device now listens to PropertiesChanged on its current IP config objects, resets the cache and emits ipV4ConfigChanged/ipV6ConfigChanged, which plasma-nm already uses to refresh the item.

commits.message:
device: refresh IP configs when their properties change

The IPv4 and IPv6 configs stayed cached until the device's config path
changed, so addresses added later to the same object, like SLAAC ones,
never showed up. Now changes on those objects reset the cached configs.

BUG: 477775

media.caption: Master: after enabling IPv6 and reconnecting, Details shows only IPv4 (left, 5 s after connecting; right, 15 s later after collapsing and re-expanding)
With the fix: right after connecting only IPv4 is known (left); 2 s later the IPv6 address and gateway appear by themselves (right)
